name: Impact Freeze Scroll Gallery
description: Vertical image gallery where each photo tumbles in 3D with blur and scale distortion, freezes sharp at screen center, then tumbles away, over a scrolling name marquee.
contents: Vertical column of images with captions-free background-image tiles
Fixed horizontal marquee of uppercase names behind the gallery
Vignette overlay and short loading bar
behavior: Each image rotates, scales, blurs and flashes brightness through scroll, holding still at mid progress
Marquee slides horizontally scrubbed by scroll
Images are offset sideways in a sine wave and repositioned on resize
editableByProps: Images, alt text and marquee names
Colors, fonts, blend mode and vignette
Tile size, aspect ratio, radius, overlap and sideways wave
3D rotation, depth, blur, scale, brightness and hold amount
Spacing above and below the column

needsCodeEdit.where: new Lenis() setup inside init in the useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the easing of the freeze

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Changes the html and body background color while mounted and resets it on unmount
Injects a Google Fonts link for Space Grotesk and Inter and a keyframes style tag into the document head
Marquee, vignette and loader overlays are fixed to the viewport
Includes top and bottom margins in vh to give the effect scroll range
